subject: Logic
title: Appeal to Nature
description: A quick, practical guide to Appeal to Nature.

hook.text: "It's natural, so it must be good for you." Arsenic is natural. So are earthquakes.

buildup.text: The appeal to nature claims what's natural is inherently good and what's artificial is bad.

discovery.text: Nature produces both medicine and poison. "Natural" is a description, not a quality judgment.

twist.text: Vaccines are artificial. Smallpox is natural. Which one would you choose?

climax.text: Evaluate things by their effects and evidence, not by whether they come from a lab or a forest.

quiz.question: Why is the appeal to nature a fallacy?
options: Natural doesn't mean good or safe
